requirement_text.note: Verbatim descriptions: handoffs/ADHOC-20261005-001/step-01-code-designer.json context.requirement_text. This step reviews a PROPOSED decision record plus a 7-line hold marker in docs/requirements.yaml.

source_text.coordinator_request: REVIEWER and SECURITY-REVIEWER must check the ADR's consistency with docs/migration/decisions/ especially 0002, 0006, 0035, 0038, 0042, 0043 and security-invariants INV-1..INV-8. Hold note requested by the coordinator: a visible hold marker on REQ-437..REQ-444 (REQ-436 already merged; REQ-439 is done so unmarked) in docs/requirements.yaml without changing status/depends_on semantics; to be removed on ratification. Do not touch Q-944/#2201 entries beyond what is needed (REQ-435 deliberately unmarked).

artifacts_in: docs/requirements.yaml (7 added `hold:` lines only; see git diff origin/main -- docs/requirements.yaml)

task.description: REVIEWER hard gate (decision-record consistency, scope creep, honesty) on docs/migration/decisions/0044-hybrid-identity-model.md at HEAD of branch docs/ADR-hybrid-identity. CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASS (after 3 reworks) and SECURITY-REVIEWER RATIFIED. Check: (1) the branch diff vs origin/main touches only the ADR, handoffs/ADHOC-20261005-001/*, handoffs/registry.json, handoffs/orchestrator.log and 7 `hold:` lines in docs/requirements.yaml (verify with git diff --stat origin/main and that the yaml still parses and no status/depends_on changed); (2) consistency with 0002, 0006, 0012, 0035, 0038, 0042, 0043: read each record's relevant passages in full and confirm every 'consistent / amends / supersedes' claim in the ADR sections 2.3.4 and 6 is true, that amend-by-reference vs supersession is chosen the way 0038/0042 chose it, and that nothing the ratified records forbid is silently done (esp. 0006 D1/R5/s7.3, 0038 four conditions, 0042 standing prohibitions 1-14, 0043 D-A..D-H and its flagged conflicts); (3) Phase 1 = O1 really leaves every ratified record intact and the PR #2201 disposition (hold, then merge with 0043 D-C delta) is consistent with 0043 D-F/D-C and with the PR's actual state (gh pr view 2201 -R tvolodi/letflow: check state/merge hold/CI); (4) scope creep: the record decides a direction and gates, it must not smuggle implementation, new requirements ids or requirement edits; the recommendation must be proportionate and the risk of over-engineering stated; (5) the claim that REQ-434..444 are 'stay' under the recommendation and the per-REQ table is accurate vs docs/requirements.yaml status/depends_on; (6) the ADR number 0044 is free (main + open PRs; note numbers get reused: identify by content); (7) the record is honest about what is unknown (Keycloak) and does not pre-empt the user's ratification. Do NOT edit anything. Output RATIFIED/PASS or FAIL with findings classified BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR and exact locations. Write the result into this handoff's 'result' (status PASS/FAIL, summary, issues[]), set status COMPLETED, take times from `date -u`; do not spawn agents; do not commit.
acceptance_criteria: Every consistency claim in the ADR checked against the source record text
PR #2201 treatment checked against the PR's real state

result.verdict: FAIL on accuracy of claims only (0 BLOCKER, 3 MAJOR, 5 MINOR); direction, scope and Phase 1 treatment are sound. Wording rework only; no re-design.
result.summary: Verified: (1) branch diff vs origin/main = ADR + handoffs (step-01/01b/02/03, registry.json, orchestrator.log) + 7 hold lines in docs/requirements.yaml; YAML parses (411 reqs both sides); all 411 requirement records identical to main once the hold key is ignored, so no status/depends_on change; holds sit exactly on REQ-437,438,440,441,442,443,444; REQ-435 unmarked. (2) Quotes and line cites of 0002 (168-175, 190-195), 0006 (30-33, 132-157, 150-152, 181-221, 296-297, 304-306), 0035 (15-17, 39-42), 0038 (47-81, 91-103), 0042 (111-114, 160-165, 417-427, 494-504), 0043 (187-192, 229-233) match source text. Code cites spot-checked (identity.ex:127,150,768; jit_provisioning_config.ex:44; claim_mapping_config.ex:58). (3) PR #2201 real state: OPEN, not draft, mergeStateStatus CLEAN, CI all SUCCESS, title carries 'MERGE HELD: pepper provisioning'; ADR 1.1 matches. Hold-then-merge-with-D-C-delta with scope unchanged is consistent with 0043 D-F/D-C and 0042 prohibition 13. (4) No implementation, no new REQ ids, no requirement edits beyond hold lines; forward reference to 'ADR 0045' is a name only; over-engineering counter-argument is stated (section 4 rationale 5, Q1 default). (5) Per-REQ table (2.3.6 and 8) matches yaml status (434/436/439 done, rest pending). (6) 0044 is free: absent on origin/main (latest is 0043); only open PRs are #2201 (touches 0042 only) and #2210 (ISS docs). (7) Keycloak facts limited to repo-pinned 26.2 and every other claim tagged UNVERIFIED with spike ids; Status PROPOSED, sign-off section pending, does not pre-empt ratification.

issues.location: 0044 section 4.3 table row O1 (line 747) 'D-C is already ratified'; also line 672 'O1 is already ratified', line 680 'exactly as ratified', line 1004 'Phase 1 is the ratified plan', section 6 title and 6.6 'CONSISTENT'
issues.finding: 0043 is NOT gate-ratified. Its header says 'decided by delegation (BA)', D-D PROPOSED, 'does not claim REVIEWER or SECURITY-REVIEWER sign-off', and it lists 10 'Conflicts flagged for REVIEWER' (D-C supersedes design 2.4/Q8/OQ-6; key-id interplay with identifiers; REQ-442 disclose flag vs prohibition 4; prohibition 13 letter amended; Decision 7 mail fence amended). Only 0042 is ratified. Phase 1 = O1 therefore inherits unresolved 0043 items.
issues.fix: Say 0042 ratified, 0043 BA-decided with REVIEWER/SECURITY-REVIEWER gates still owed; reword 'already ratified' for D-C; add one sentence in 6.6 that 0043 conflicts 1-10 remain open and are not settled by 0044.

issues.finding: Amendment list for 0038 is incomplete. Only point 4 is named as amended. 0038 'What remains foreclosed' bullet 2 (0038 lines 95-97: no mechanism letting AuthPipeline realm-to-tenant resolution consult anything other than tenants.idp_realm_id) is directly contradicted by the shared-realm branch (shared_identity_realms + selector + membership), and 0042 (lines 193-196) reaffirmed that bullet 'remain foreclosed verbatim'. 6.4 says 'still honoured for tenant_memberships' and mentions only the unauthenticated-lookup bullet. This is exactly sign-off ask (b); the sentence that is changed must be quoted.
issues.fix: In 6.4 and 6.5 list 0038 bullet 2 (and 0042's reaffirmation) as AMENDED in Phase 2 for the shared realm, quoted, and note the 'single users row serving more than one tenant' half stays true.

issues.location: 0044 section 6.5 line 917 ('Standing prohibitions ... 12-14 CONSISTENT in Phases 1-3'), sections 2.3.6/8 REQ-441 rows, 2.3.2 item 4, 2.3.8, 4.2 Phase 3
issues.finding: Phase 3 uses the REQ-441 mail adapter to deliver invitations. 0042 prohibition 12 allows only a fixed template carrying no text derived from the request other than the recipient, and 0043 D-B says the port is 'not widened' for invitations. An invitation mail needs a new template/link, i.e. an amendment to prohibition 12 and D-B, so 'consistent in Phases 1-3' is untrue for Phase 3. Related: prohibition 14 (any user-deleting/purging path must call remove_entry_if_unreferenced/3 in the same transaction) is not cited by the Phase 3 offboarding 'purge per policy' (2.3.5 item 6).
issues.fix: Move 12 (and note D-B) into the AMENDS list for Phase 3 with SECURITY-REVIEWER gate; cite prohibition 14 in the offboarding requirement scope.

issues.location: 0044 section 2.3.2 (lines 334-337) and 2.3.6 REQ-440 row / section 8 REQ-440 row vs 2.3.4 (a)-(b)
issues.finding: Internal contradiction: 2.3.2 and the REQ-440 rows say shared users are written 'through the same Identity functions/transactions', while 2.3.4 requires a DISTINCT writer that must not reuse provision_oidc_user/4 and makes the other writers refuse the shared realm. REQ-440's four-function hook list therefore does not cover the new writer; it needs its own hook in a Phase 2/3 requirement. 'stay' verdict still holds.
issues.fix: Reword the two REQ-440 rows and 2.3.2 to 'same hook/removal rule, applied to the new invitation writer by a new requirement'.

issues.location: 0044 section 4.3 O3 row 'HOLD until ratification' vs Hold note (lines 1045-1048) and section 8 REQ-435 row 'stay (hold until ratified)'
issues.finding: Three different statements of REQ-435/PR #2201 hold: the O3 row and section 8 say hold until ratification; the Hold note says REQ-435 carries no marker and is held only by the independent pepper hold. The PR is actually CLEAN with green CI and held only by its title/pepper provisioning; 0043 D-F says the record does not touch the PR. Also the D-C delta is described as key id + dual-read only, while 0043 flagged conflict 3 also names REQ-443 tooling.
issues.fix: Make section 4.3 and 8 say 'no new hold added by 0044; the existing pepper hold governs; recommendation is not to merge before ratification' and align the delta wording.

issues.location: 0044 section 4.2 Phase 0 and section 7 Q1/Q9 defaults
issues.finding: Proportionality: default answers (Q1: tens of tenants, do NOT start Phase 2; Q9: no SSO customer, Phase 4 not scheduled) mean Phase 0 spike (3-4 steps) is also unneeded by default, but Phase 0 is not stated as conditional on Q1. Recommending 'adopt O3 as direction' while the default answer is Phase 1 only slightly pre-commits.
issues.fix: State that Phase 0 starts only on a Q1 answer that wants the shared tier.

issues.finding: Handoff scope lists 0012 but section 6 has no 0012 entry (MOB-5 conflict is handled in R-11/Q10). Also 'This is the shape 0038 already allowed' overstates: 0038 condition 3 describes rows created via each tenant's own realm and JIT, whereas shared rows are created by invitation in a common realm; 0038 forbids nothing here but did not 'allow' it.
issues.fix: Add a 6.x for 0012 (CONSISTENT; MOB-5 wording is in docs/mobile, revised first) and soften the 0038 sentence.

issues.finding: `hold` is a new, undeclared requirement key. YAML parses and nothing else changed, but I did not verify that REQ-VALIDATOR/letflow-queue tooling honours or tolerates the key; the marker is advisory text only and does not by itself stop a claim. Acceptable as a temporary marker if ORCH also withholds those ids from get_next_task.
issues.fix: ORCH to confirm queue behaviour; remove markers on ratification as the ADR states.

issues.finding: No code changed; no type-safety issue filed (nothing under docs/issues/ created). Phase 2 design items (realm-kind decided once, typed deny for unconfigured realm) are candidates for type-level modelling when designed.

result.decision_record_disagreement: None. 0044 does not contradict any ratified record in Phase 1; Phase 2+ amendments are declared, with the omissions in RV-2/RV-3.
